text:
sam: Hey all, running into a nasty combo: rerank + embed batcher + auth retry. The rerank results appear to be interleaved with embeddings when the client retries and the SDKs disagree on score field. Minimal repro below.

jess: Hmm, give me the request/response examples and which SDKs.

sam: Node SDK 0.13.0, Py SDK 0.10.2. Request: batch of 3 docs for embed+rerank. Client posts:
```json
{"items":[{"id":"d1","text":"doc A"},{"id":"d2","text":"doc B"},{"id":"d3","text":"doc C"}],"mode":"embed+rerank","req_id":"RR-900"}
```
Server responses seen:
Node combined adapter resp:
```json
{"embeddings":[{"id":"d1","embedding":[0.01,0.02],"score":0.72},{"id":"d2","embedding":[0.03,0.04],"score":0.65},{"id":"d3","embedding":[0.05,0.06],"score":0.81}]}
```
Python raw resp (same call, retry after 401):
```json
[{"id":"d2","vector":[0.03,0.04],"rank_score":65},{"id":"d1","vector":[0.01,0.02],"rank_score":72},{"id":"d3","vector":[0.05,0.06],"rank_score":81}]
```
Notes: python returns `vector` not `embedding`, uses `rank_score` as integer percent (65 vs 0.65), and order is d2,d1,d3.

mike: That explains duplicates downstream: upsert assumes aligned positions. Also score scaling mismatch will break rerank thresholds. The retry log shows a token expiry on subrequest 1 then full-batch retry without X-Request-ID.

ria: Server logs: "auth: token expired for subreq idx=1 -> client retried entire payload; processed batch order: d2,d1,d3". So it's ordering loss + field name + score scaling. Looks like two problems: SDK normalization + batch helper ordering.

sam: I traced it: python SDK's batcher builds a dict keyed by id then returns list(dict.values()) — insertion order can change when retries merge partial responses. Also python's rerank adapter maps `score` differently (multiplies by 100) because of an old compatibility layer. Patchable.

jess: Action items:
- SDKs: canonicalize fields to `embedding` and `score` (float 0-1), add per-item `_pos` in request payload and persist it through responses.
- Sampleapp: include `X-Request-ID` header and per-item idempotency tokens. Make retry logic only resend failed items when possible.
- Server: accept partial-retries endpoint and honor X-Request-ID to dedupe. Also emit diagnostics header `X-Processed-Order` for debugging.

mike: I'll add unit/integration tests to both SDKs that simulate auth expiry mid-batch and assert ordering and normalized fields.

ria: Also suggest a small backward-compat shim in server: if it sees `rank_score` or `vector` normalize before sending to SDKs. Prevents wild inconsistencies during rolling upgrades.

sam: For quick unblock I'll push a sampleapp PR adding `_pos`, `X-Request-ID` and a small adapter that maps `vector`->`embedding` and `rank_score`->`score`/100. Will attach test and re-run e2e.

bot-ci: CI: sampleapp-onboard-e2e #789 failed: assert "scores normalized". See https://ci.redwood/789

jess: Filed GH issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/5123 "rerank+embed: ensure ordering, normalize fields & idempotency" — assigned to @mike and @sam.

sam: thanks, pushing PR now. ping me on thread if you want to replicate locally. :slightly_smiling_face:
